items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] -- Barney Kessel? Those kind of guys. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes - big band guitar - really marvelous.

ctx.x: -- Barney Kessel? Those kind of guys.

Yes - big band guitar - really marvelous. And, I've been there three times and then I went to Monte Carlo with the Pa Pa Bue Band and we did a great big thing for IBM and they put us up in the best hotel in town; we played three days there; so - you see - over there, I just keep going. I play Norway - I just came back.
